contractVersion.description: Strict semver contract version carried by every wire object. Decoders accept the same major version; any other version is a typed error.

description.description: Human-readable place description (e.g. 'the affected wall faces'); presentation only — excluded from identity derivations.

geometryRefs.description: Deterministic geometry references anchoring or limiting the target (drawn pit outlines, wall face polygons…).

ref.description: Stable id of the referenced geometry artifact (owned by the deterministic geometry services; read-only reference).

nodeRefs.description: Stable Reality Graph node ids the target anchors to (read-only references to observed reality).

items.description: Opaque stable identifier assigned by the authority that owns the object.

selectorKind.description: How the target selects space: element (whole node), face-set (element faces), surface-region, volume, line-extent, point, storey or space.

units.description: Units of the spatial coordinates/anchors (carried verbatim).

angular.description: Angular unit of the target's anchors (e.g. rad).

linear.description: Linear unit of the target's anchors (e.g. m).
